$comment: Auto-mode setup. Auto mode does its work through Bash, so the prompts that
matter are the read-only inspection commands it runs constantly. Everything
in `allow` reads or verifies and changes nothing; anything that writes,
installs, or publishes is deliberately absent, so it still asks.
`deny` is short on purpose — only the commands that silently destroy
uncommitted work. `git checkout HEAD -- <file>` is there because it cost
real work on 2026-08-22: several Claude sessions and an editor were editing
this repo at once, and that command discarded another session's in-progress
file with no way to get it back from git. Drop any of these if they get in
the way — they are a seatbelt, not a policy.
